summary: Designed for quick, precise leveling of alignment telescopes and collimators to one arcsecond.
specs: Can also be used to level any cylindrical surface between 1¾” and 3” in diameter.
Both ends are viewed simultaneously via prisms and a magnification system.
“Coincidence” or “split” bubble presentation provides the most accurate reading of the bubble position.
Top-mounted turret assembly rotates 360°, allowing viewing from all sides.
Elastic strap is included to secure the level to the instrument.
title: 621871 Stride Level
